predicate.label: has diplomatic relations with
predicate.definition: Country or government X maintains or maintained diplomatic relations with country or government Y.
includes: an ambassador of X accredited to Y
excludes: ordinary trade, physical travel, or war alone
an ambassador merely visiting Y without accreditation
ambiguous: generic relationship or relation without diplomatic context
unclear ambassador accreditation or country attachment
predicate.notes: Diplomatic relations do not imply alliance, friendship, or agreement on policy.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit diplomatic relations; an ambassador of X accredited to Y; historical diplomatic relations. Excludes: ordinary trade, physical travel, or war alone; generic political or personal association; an ambassador merely visiting Y without accreditation; proposed relations without establishment. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic relationship or relation without diplomatic context; unclear government versus private entity; unclear ambassador accreditation or country attachment. Diplomatic relations do not imply alliance, friendship, or agreement on policy.

rationale: Country-to-country ambassador-to, relation-with and relationship-with paths dominate. Diplomatic relations is the coherent family; generic relationships alone retain uncertainty and person-to-person communication is separate.
